header: Manage predictive shielding in Microsoft Defender (Preview)
content:
Defender (Preview)
Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Microsoft Defender uses predictive shielding (Preview) as a proactive defense strategy
designed to anticipate and mitigate threats before they materialize. Learn how predictive
shielding works to dynamically infer risk, anticipate attacker progression, and harden your
environment.
This article describes how to manage predictive shielding so that you can enrich your
prediction data and understand how predictive shielding actions are applied in your
environment.
The incident view in Microsoft Defender includes built-in predictive shielding details. Use the
incident graph and activity information to assess the predictive shielding impact and status.
In the Incidents page, filter by the Predictive Shielding tag to find incidents where predictive
shielding is applied.
